hero.tagline: Hi, I'm Isaac. Developer specialized in backend, scalable cloud infrastructure with AWS and secure APIs.

about.label: About Me
about.title: Driven by curiosity
paragraphs: I have completed my Higher Vocational Training in Multi-Platform Application Development and I'm currently studying for a BSc (Hons) in Cyber Security at York St John University. Over these years I've grown interested in Python development, data management with SQL and the wide range of services offered by AWS. I'm planning several personal and academic projects to reinforce and expand my knowledge of technologies that are valuable in today's market.
I consider myself a curious, proactive person eager to learn. I enjoy picking up new technologies and applying them to my projects.

armario.title: Armario — AI-powered virtual wardrobe
armario.description: PWA that turns photos of your clothes into a digital wardrobe: it removes the background and classifies each garment with Claude on Amazon Bedrock through an asynchronous EventBridge pipeline. Compose outfits, log what you wear and get daily suggestions based on the weather.

mynotes.title: MyNotes — Study management
mynotes.description: Installable PWA for organising studies: Markdown notes and files, an exam and deadline calendar, a Pomodoro timer and spaced-repetition flashcards (FSRS). Hono API on a single Lambda secured with Cognito, with data isolated per user.
